openai_images.name: ChatGPT / OpenAI image generation
openai_images.description: Future hosted package. Requires its own connection, generation adapter and model-specific planner recipes; no local model download.

flux_high.name: High End - FLUX.2
flux_high.description: FLUX.2 klein 4B with the FLUX outpainting adapter for detailed instruction-based editing.

sdxl_mid.name: Mid Tier - SDXL
sdxl_mid.description: SDXL 1.0 for Mirror scenes and a dedicated SDXL inpainting model for Edit. Its recipes remain experimental.

turbo_light.name: Lightweight - SD-Turbo
turbo_light.description: A smaller, faster image model for experiments. Includes the same shared artwork analyzer as the larger packages.

classic_edit.name: Classic Editing - SD 1.5 / InstructPix2Pix
classic_edit.description: Two alternative editing models. InstructPix2Pix supports replacement and removal, but does not support Extend artwork or Mirror outpainting.
